description: By action: "list" (the default) shows connected tabs; "yield" is MANDATORY before you stop; "tune" hides or moves the HUD; "feedback" reports a problem. e.g. {"action":"yield","mode":"waiting"}

all.description: Include already-resolved marks in the listing (default: pending only).

claim.description: What YOU claim this session showed.

contact.description: An email address for a reply from the maintainers.

currentApproach.description: How you work around it TODAY.

disconnect.description: Also detach this page for good (needs sessionId).

hud.description: Hide, show or remove the HUD, or move it to a corner.

idleEndMs.description: Idle window in milliseconds after which the panel shows WAITING (your turn).

impact.description: What measurably improves — fewer tool calls, fewer retries, a verdict that stops being ambiguous, a flow you currently cannot verify at all.

kind.description: bug = a Reticle tool returned a wrong or broken result; gap = Reticle could not observe something you needed at all; ambiguity = the verification ran but you c…

mode.description: "waiting" = turn done, will resume; "ask" = blocked, need the human to answer.

need.description: The GOAL behind a request, not the request itself.

note.description: For mode:"ask", the question to show the human on the panel.

rating.description: How well it worked, 1-5, with an `experience`.

resolve.description: A mark id (e.g. "m1") to retire after you have fixed it.

sessionId.description: Target a specific tab. Omit unless you mean one — see instructions.

summary.description: One sentence: what this session proved.

text.description: Short sentence describing your next action, shown on the presenter HUD for the developer watching.

trace.description: The literal tool calls and responses that led here, so the failure can be reproduced without guessing.

name: reticle_session
